name: spoofed-chrome-wildcard-accept
provenance: Captured 2026-08-24 from curl 7.88.1 called with -A set to the Chrome 152 User-Agent from chrome-pixel, requesting a pixel path on a local header-echo server. Verbatim apart from the dropped Host header: a browser identity string over a script header set, which is what the typed-accept and declared-signal checks exist to separate. Deliberately not class "bot", because an unwired pipeline cannot tell this apart from a browser and the routing suite scores it instead.
